{{Quote|The attack on Soontir Fel? I thought that concerned the aid he provided the Galactic Alliance against the Yuuzhan Vong.|Mara Jade Skywalker|<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
The '''attack on Soontir Fel'''<ref name="DN1" /> occurred on [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], between a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] team on the [[Hunt for Zonama Sekot|hunt]] for [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]], and rogue [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] elements under the command of [[Ina'ganet'nuruodo|Ganet]]. Although the Chiss managed to bring the [[ice barge]] the group were traveling with to a halt, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the team defeated the [[snow-flier]]s that were sent against them. Concurrently, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] foiled [[Chief Navigator]] [[Peita Aabe]]'s attempt to kidnap [[Wynssa Fel]].
